name: Kono Musume-tachi wa H mo Oshikko mo Gaman Dekinai!!
original_name: この娘達はHもおしっこも我慢できない‼
source:
In the first autumn of his new school life the protagonist Yoshito participates in the extra curriculum outdoor activity. In this event he meets three girls who all pee in panties! Three day stay at a hotel in the middle of the mountain is eventful with cute girls!
